items.headline: I'M THE SAME OUT NOW
body: Lockslip returns with their final single "IM THE SAME" ahead of their debut album "THE CONVERSATION"s release next week on November 6th.
"IM THE SAME" sees Lockslip take their wall of sound aggression to melodic spaces without compromising integrity or intensity.
IM THE SAME is available now via bleakhouse

"I'm the Same" is a two-minute burst of relentless blasting and cathartic vocals, crowned by a spiraling, wistful guitar melody that tips the hat to the band's screamo influences. It is a juxtaposition of elements – the punishing and the pensive – that brings to mind contemporaries such as Cloud Rat and Converge.

For the official "I'm the Same" music video, the band teamed up with digital artist @Freeculture.api, who delivered a deliciously retro, Y2K-era aesthetic, depicting a chilling vampiric tale, just in time for Halloween. Drummer Noah Baxter elaborates: "Freeculture.api is a digital artist I've followed for years now, part of this renaissance of low poly and early 3D revival in computer art and animation. Growing up, I spent a lot of time in these 3D digital spaces, sometimes surrounded by others but more often alone with my thoughts, so when this song came together and I read Sara's lyrics it just made sense to me, as a way to visually describe the alien and abstract way we actually inhabit our own heads."

items.headline: VENGEANCE (YOU'LL BE SEEN BY YOUR GOD) OUT NOW
body: Los Angeles’ Lockslip have released new single “Vengeance (You’ll Be Seen By Your God).”
“Vengeance (You’ll Be Seen By Your God)” is the second single to be revealed from the band’s upcoming new album, The Conversation, coming November 6th on Bleakhouse.
See the official music video premiering exclusively through @cvltnation

“Vengeance (You’ll Be Seen By Your God)” exemplifies Lockslip’s style: a metallic hardcore stampede, marked by breakneck drumming, world-ending breakdowns, and lustrous melodic passages appearing like sunlight through storm clouds.

While the quintet cruises through multiple time signatures and wields fiery chops inspired by the likes of The Dillinger Escape Plan, the shredding is done in service of something bigger. Lockslip’s real power lies in its emotional impact – a sense of bleeding-heart urgency and runaway-train momentum that brings to mind the great Converge.

Vocalist Sara G delivers every word with absolute conviction, as if drawing from a bottomless well of horror. “The state of the world is complex, it’s dark, and it’s unpredictable, so we want to write music that reflects those anxieties,” says G.

items.headline: GRAY WORLD FT. KING YOSEF OUT NOW
body: Lockslip’s debut bleakhouse single “GRAY WORLD FT. KING YOSEF” is out now with a music video. Watch or stream it on your preferred platform.
Lockslip’s debut album “THE CONVERSATION” is due out November 6th via bleakhouse. Pre-orders are now live.
From Los Angeles, Lockslip delivers a punishing brand of hardcore inspired equally by Converge’s bleeding-heart authenticity as by Car Bomb’s kaleidoscopic complexity.
On new album The Conversation, Lockslip’s songs are powered by inexorable momentum, like blind horses barreling down mountainsides.
Noah Baxter’s breakneck drumming fuels Lockslip’s stampedes, leading to world-ending breakdowns courtesy of guitarists TJ Jaeger and Nick Pinder and bassist Enrique Isla-Eisenacher.
Above the fray, lustrous melodic passages occasionally appear like sunlight through storm clouds. Sara G screams every word with absolute conviction, as if drawing from a bottomless well of horror.
“THE CONVERSATION” is the sound of a band pushing all the way to the edge – musically, emotionally, in the red.

items.headline: LOCKSLIP SIGNS TO BLEAKHOUSE
body: we are very excited to finally announce los angeles based metallic hardcore band, lockslip, as an official bleakhouse artist.
this is one announcement of many to come as we welcome lockslip into the family and begin our work together. if you aren’t already familiar with the 5 piece, now is your chance.
welcome to bleakhouse.
